ref: ADR-0006 TargetSlots, assumed readings: a SUPPRESS slot creates nothing but keeps its number, so it consumes its child context; SUPPRESS does not count toward minOccurs / maxOccurs; truncated slots keep their numbers; createIf is true for 1 or true in any case (since #51); obs-target-creation decides (#31)
note: Item per createIf(Sku) in context Orders: "", SUPPRESS, "" for Sku 1, no, true. V per Qty in its default context Line: 10 | 20 | 30. The SUPPRESS slot 2 creates no Item but consumes Qty context 2, so the second Item reads context 3: V 10, then V 30. Renumbering the created slots would give V 10, then V 20.
